detail.longDescription: I am trying to make a pixel-based simulation, and am having some performance issues. I thought I could use numbas JIT-compilation to speed it up, but when I run the code it runs ~14% slower. This is the code: @jit(nopython=True) def update(pixels): new_pixels = [1 for _ in range(grid_size[0]*grid_size[1])] for y in range(grid_size[1]): for x in range(grid_size[0]): pixel = pixels[x + y*grid_size[0]] u = pixels[x + (y-1)*grid_size[0]] if y-1 >= 0 else 0 d = pixels[x + (y+1)*grid_size[0]] if y+1 < grid_size[1] else 0 if pixel in [1, 4, 9]: # if pixel is air, smoke or steam if u == 2: # if up is gravel new_pixels[x + y*grid_size[0]] = 2 elif u == 3: # if up is sand new_pixels[x + y*grid_size[0]] = 3 else: new_pixels[x + y*grid_size[0]] = pixel elif pixel == 2: # if pixel is gravel if d in [1, 4, 9]: # if down is air, smoke or steam new_pixels[x + y*grid_size[0]] = d else: new_pixels[x + y*grid_size[0]] = pixel elif pixel == 3: # if pixel is sand if d in [1, 4, 9]: # if down is air, smoke or steam new_pixels[x + y*grid_size[0]] = d else: new_pixels[x + y*grid_size[0]] = pixel else: new_pixels[x + y*grid_size[0]] = pixel return new_pixels This code is not complete, and I will add many more substances with much more complex functionality, but I thought that JIT-compilation would help here. I also tried to make it run in parallel, but the diagnostics said it didn't find a source: Parallel Accelerator Optimizing: Function update, /home/me/my_dir/simulation.py (62) ================================================================================ No source available --------------------------------- Fusing loops --------------------------------- Attempting fusion of parallel loops (combines loops with similar properties)... ----------------------------- Before Optimisation ------------------------------ -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ------------------------------ After Optimisation ------------------------------ Parallel structure is already optimal. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------------------------Loop invariant code motion--------------------------- Allocation hoisting: No allocation hoisting found Instruction hoisting: No instruction hoisting found -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- What is happening here?
